budget_items.topic: Sewer pro-rations on change of ownership
budget_items.what_was_recorded: New owners are billed the full minimum quarterly charge under the 2010 no-prorating policy; the Commission agreed to move to monthly prorating.
budget_items.quote: all new owners are billed the minimum charge of $107 at the minimum for the quarter when they took ownership

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current flat rate for well owners was stated as the figure printed.
budget_items.quote: barb noted the current flat rate for well owners is $231.87/quarter 1833cf).

budget_items.topic: Cost of installing a well meter
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb estimated the total cost to install a meter on a well.
budget_items.quote: barb noted the total cost to install a meter would be about $1,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two flow-meter-based invoices were reported for the sewer costs.

budget_items.topic: Leominster costs compared with last year
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster costs at the same point in the year were reported for last year and this year.
budget_items.quote: barb replied that at this same time, last year's costs were $309k and this year $362k, with 3 quarters of flow meter readings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb reported the FY21 budget looks good, with revenues up and expenses within range.
budget_items.quote: barb reported the fy21 budget looks good, with revenues up ($927, 133) and expenses within range ($909k).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two inflow/infiltration quotes were received; Green Mountain was selected at a lower cost than the other quote.
budget_items.quote: national water main cleaning was around $18k and green mountain quoted $6,500 for labor plus grout cost per gallon for under $10k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rob said the work cost would come out of the I/I expense line.
budget_items.quote: rob said the cost will come out of i/l expense line.
